title: High Probability Risk Control for Online Policy Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.13163v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study risk control for online policy learning, where an agent adaptively collects data and aims to learn a new policy whose risk stays below a tolerance threshold at every round with high probability. Such policy updates and data collection induce feedback covariate shift (FCS): observed data depend on history through evolving policies and the data-collection process. FCS brings two substantive problems for risk control: 1) efficient risk evaluation for each candidate policy and 2) valid policy selection with high-probability risk control. To address these, we propose a permutation-based weighted risk evaluator with weights efficiently approximated by the Sinkhorn algorithm and select policies whose estimated risk upper confidence bounds (UCB) fall below the target threshold, with the UCB obtained through a proposed Gaussian bootstrap method. translated_title: 在线策略学习的高概率风险控制
translated_abstract: 我们研究在线策略学习的风险控制问题，其中智能体自适应地收集数据，旨在学习一个新策略，使其风险在每一轮都以高概率保持在容忍阈值以下。这种策略更新和数据收集过程会引发反馈协变量偏移（FCS）：观测数据通过不断演化的策略和数据收集过程依赖于历史。FCS给风险控制带来了两个实质性难题：1）对每个候选策略进行高效的风险评估；2）在高概率风险控制下进行有效的策略选择。为解决这些问题，我们提出了一种基于置换的加权风险评估器，其权重通过Sinkhorn算法高效近似，并选择估计风险置信上界（UCB）低于目标阈值的策略，其中UCB通过我们提出的高斯自助法获得。理论上，我们证明了我们的风险评估器的方差上界不超过……
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于置换的加权风险评估器（权重由Sinkhorn算法高效近似）结合高斯自助法构造风险置信上界，从而在反馈协变量偏移下实现高概率风险控制的在线策略选择。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a permutation-based weighted risk evaluator (with weights efficiently approximated via the Sinkhorn algorithm) combined with a Gaussian bootstrap method to construct risk upper confidence bounds, enabling valid policy selection with high-probability risk control under feedback covariate shift in online policy learning.
